card.name: Final word of a long compound term
card.fires_on: The last word that completes a long multiword name or term, such as syndrome, agonist or Trial, right before a bracket, parenthesis or new clause.

modes.label: Ends of medical names
modes.description: The closing word of a named syndrome, drug class or study title.
modes.example: IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL-ASSOCIATED NEUROTOXICITY SYND<<ROME>> See full prescribing

modes.label: Ends of general titles
modes.description: The head noun finishing a descriptive phrase or event name in ordinary web text.
modes.example: "World Religions-Dialogue and Symphony"<< conference>> convened by Hindu preacher Morari Bap

card.plain: It marks the last word of a long multiword name, just before the text moves on.
